blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The No Contact Apprehension Policy (NCAP) will be reimplemented in the City of Manila, Muntinlupa, City, Parañaque City, Quezon City, San Juan City and Valenzuela City starting Monday, October 5. READ: SC lifts TRO, dismisses 3 petitions vs NCAP Under the reimplementation, the standardized fines will apply under cities covered by the NCAP in line with the Metro Manila Traffic Code of 2023. The NCAP provides for the digital recording of traffic violations through a closed-circuit television and high-speed cameras.
